nodes.label: ADR-015 Single active edit approval and session
nodes.summary: Accepted MVP decision: one pending/approved approval and one active edit session per revision, guarded after transactional row lock.
nodes.rationale: Parallel approval/edit paths obscure scope and audit ordering, including on legacy duplicate approvals.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Transactional single active approval guard
nodes.summary: One pending/approved approval and no competing active session per revision, checked under row lock including legacy duplicates.
nodes.rationale: Prevent conflicting authority scopes and parallel edit audit ambiguity.

nodes.label: Inline expired approval reconciliation
nodes.summary: New request marks approved-but-expired records expired transactionally, allowing renewed approval without waiting for scheduler.
nodes.rationale: Stale lifecycle records should not block a legitimate later emergency session.

edges.evidence: Both serialize authority/state decisions against a locked latest proposal to prevent stale parallel actions.
